name: fld_sqrt_three_not_in_Q_sqrt_two
statement: (a b : ℚ) : Real.sqrt 3 ≠ (a : ℝ) + (b : ℝ) * Real.sqrt 2
closed: ∀ (a b : ℚ), Real.sqrt 3 ≠ (a : ℝ) + (b : ℝ) * Real.sqrt 2
informal: √3 ∉ ℚ(√2) — squaring gives 3 = a^2 + 2b^2 + 2ab√2, so ab = 0 by irrationality of √2; b = 0 gives √3 = a rational, a = 0 gives 3 = 2b^2, i.e. (2b)^2 = 6, contradicting irrationality of √6.
